notes.title: Daily challenge update and free week!
notes.notes:
Hey all!

Hope the wait wasn't too long for everyoneːsteamhappyː It’s time we bring a new feature into the game! So if you’re interested, check out this video right here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DEQJ4ra0oO8
Indeed, we've added a daily challenge to the game. Every day there will be a random level, along with a random mutator for you to try and finish. Some of these will be insanely hard for even the most hardcore players out there! Let's see if all of you are up for the (daily) challenge!ːsteammockingː 

Also, this week you can try Action Henk for free on Steam, so tell all your friends to check it out! And let's welcome everybody who is new to the game into this wonderful community of awesome people! To everyone who got here from the free week to check this announcement, good day to you, and thanks for checking out the game! <3

notes.title: Spooky times with a new update!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/HHsJyIt.jpg[/img]

Hey Everyone!

Do you guys dare to unlock HallowHenk and Wicked Betsy? Two new skins available to unlock during Halloween only, time to gotta ghost fast! 

While working hard on the console version together with Curve Digital, we also managed to build an update for this Halloween. We’ve been working together with the community to fix some issues related to the leaderboards, and added some extra features as well! A big thank you to all the lovely people that helped us and put so much effort into making Action Henk a better game. Always amazed by everyone’s dedication!    

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]HallowHenk and Wicked Betsy can be unlocked for the next two weeks by completing all Halloween levels (for henk) or completing all Night levels (for betsy). (Challenge & bonus levels excluded)
[*]The global overall leaderboard now fetches your steam times to calculate a final score rather than using your (sometimes broken) local bests. Please note it can take a good minute after starting up for your new score to be calculated. After that any new highscore should instantly update your global overall score.
[*]While selecting levels for multiplayer there is also a randomize button which selects a random set of levels.
[*]Way of the Ninja geometry added to fix the camera issues in the beginning
[*]Developer console disabled. All skins obtained through the ‘unlock all’ command which are not unlockable in the game will be disabled again.
[*]Anti-Macro system. We’ve been looking into this and decided the best solution is to limit the player jump input to 10 jumps per second (one jump every 0.1 seconds). Every jump press above this speed will be ignored. This way we can still have the interesting trick of tapping multiple jumps to gain speed, while still keeping it at a human maximum. What this also means is that over the course of the next weeks we will start cleaning up some of the leaderboards that now have broken replays. Please note that as we are doing this we will keep track of everything we had to delete, so everyone can see if they need to re-do certain levels.
[*]Fixed a bug where the special thanks credits would show up in regular levels.
[*]Fixed a bug where pressing soft-reset (enter) in multiplayer would have you jump all the way to the start on other clients.
[*]World Champion skin added for our AHWC winner Activy!
[/list]

[b]Experimental changes:[/b]
Based on community feedback we have added some experimental features. These features are still rough around the edges and have a good chance of breaking at certain points. By keeping it to basic functionality rather than full polished goodness we were able to easily implement these features without having to spend weeks on making it work perfectly in every situation.
[list]
[*]You can now watch your [i]own[/i] replays for bonus & challenge levels. Replays of other people are still inaccessible.
[*]Multiplayer spectator mode is available for everyone! This feature was originally built for the Action Henk World Championships, but there were many requests to keep it in. You can use it by holding the left-shift key and pressing 1-9. The camera will then focus different players in your multiplayer match
[*]Replay playback options! While watching a replay you can press control + left arrow or right arrow to jump back or forward in time. This feature is a little jumpy, but it provides a decent way to watch just a small portion of a replay without having to wait for it to loop completely.
[/list]

[b]Community Highlights:[/b]
The first Action Henk World Championships have definitely been a success! Congratulations Activy for getting 1st place! Also good job Seraphimo27 and Magg the Sloth for getting respectively 2nd and 3rd! If you’re curious check out the [url=http://actionhenk.com/ahwc_brackets.png]tournament brackets[/url]. Be sure to also check out [url=https://www.youtube.com/user/ThePersuitOfInfinity/videos]Goku’s Youtube channel[/url] if you want to relive some of the action.
Thanks everyone for being involved and there is definitely more to come!

notes.title: Action Henk's first post-launch update is now live!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/SQLMtdg.jpg[/img]

Hey Everyone!

It’s been 2 weeks since launch now, and we have been taking a bit of time off to recover from the hectic crunch time. However, we have already been sitting down and prepared a small update fixing some problems based on the initial feedback and bug reports we have been getting. Be sure to let us know if you still run into any issues, we are eager to fix any problems that arise!

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]You can now see what you did to earn a particular skin in the character selection screen.
[*]Multiplayer chat window got an overhaul.
[*]We disabled 3 achievements because they were handed out to some players without the criteria of the achievements being met. We’re looking into it.
[*]Fixed a bug where the game would sometimes crash when switching levels in multiplayer.
[*]Fixed a bug where the player sometimes couldn’t add Workshop levels to a multiplayer server level rotation.
[/list]

[b]Community Highlights:[/b]
If you have a spare 2858 minutes, check out [url=http://www.twitch.tv/manvsgame/v/5037599]MANvsGAME’s 48-hour stream![/url]
To honor MAN’s dedication we implemented an achievement in his name, all you have to do to unlock it is complete every campaign level (excluding city & bonus levels) in one session. This will also reward you with a MANvsGAME themed skin for Henk. Good luck! 

[b]Coming up:[/b]
There’s still a couple of things we would like to fix in the near future, like for example uploading personal bests in multiplayer matches that many people have been asking for. We also want to take a closer look at the performance issues some people have been getting on the Mac version. These are just a couple of the things we still want to look into, so don’t hesitate to let us know if you run into any bugs or issues, we will keep improving the game!

notes.title: Action Henk release date announcement!
notes.notes:
It's finally coming! We're proud to announce that the full version of Action Henk will launch in a couple of weeks, on May 11.

Check out the entire 18 month progress from start to finish in our announcement trailer!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NYk5T6P8PDY
We've got a whole bunch of cool features and content ready for the final version, and we hope you'll enjoy playing it as much as we did making it!

It's been one hell of a ride, and we want to thank everyone who has been part of this adventure!

Make sure to keep a look out on our [url=https://www.facebook.com/RageSquid]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/ragesquid]Twitter[/url] for more announcements and sneak peeks!

notes.title: A small update from the RageSquid team!
notes.notes:
[img]http://ragesquid.com/henk/water.png[/img]

Hey guys!
We've been quiet for a while but I'm here to give you a small update on what we've been up to.
The past couple of weeks have been busy, some of us went to the USA to visit GDC in San Francisco and we had a little Action Henk stand at SXSW in Austin, we had a ton of fun over there and we met a lot of amazing players and other developers. 

Meanwhile back home we moved offices again, we're in a big new building (still in Utrecht) with lots of other game studios, it's a great environment to be in. 

Work on Henk hasn't been standing still, though. A lot of content has been finished up and it's looking great. Right now we're tying up all loose ends and the end of development is finally in sight. We're looking to release the game somewhere in the next month or two and I can promise that the final version of the game will definitely be a significant step up from the last Early Access version you guys are playing right now. 

I really can't wait to reveal to you all the final version (and I'm probably speaking for the entire team here). Working on it has been amazing and I'd like to thank you all for the support and sticking with us <3

Now, time to get back to work. We'll keep you up to date when we've picked a launch date!

-Lex

notes.title: Early Access v7 - Halloween Update is live!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.ragesquid.com/press/action_henk/images/halloween_02.png[/img]

It’s Halloween, time for treats! We’re proud to introduce a new visual style. Next to the ‘kids room’ environment that we’re all familiar with, we now present to you a brand new spooky Halloween themed version of the room! Feast your eyes on all of the new visuals in the Halloween levels! 

[b]Levels:[/b]
There’s a whole new batch of levels, the Halloween batch. Six levels in the new visual style!
[list]
[*]New: Gotta Ghost Fast (Medium).
[*]New: Wicked Waves (Medium). 
[*]New: Cursed Curves (Medium).
[*]New: Deadly Drops (Medium).
[*]New: Tricks & Treats (Medium).
[*]New: Kentony Challenge 1 (Medium, Challenge level).
[/list]
Other level changes/fixes
[list]
[*]New: Getting Hooked (Easy, Hook level).
[*]The ending of Betsy’s Challenge is changed to be a bit easier.
[*]Fixed a bug in Tornado where you could skip a part of the level and mess up the physics.
[*]Renamed: First Steps is now called Back 2 Back.
[*]Renamed: Hook Shot is now called Smooth Swinging.
[/list]
[b]Audio:[/b]
[list]
[*]New song: Halloween theme.
[*]All tracks remastered.
[*]Music played is now related to level batches instead of the current character.
[/list]
[b]Characters/Skins:[/b]
[list]
[*]Two new Halloween themed skins. Hallowhenk and Wicked Betsy.
[/list]
[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]Floor is lava received another facelift.
[*]We’ve begun implementing Steam Achievements! For now we have two. One for the Betsy challenge and one for the new challenge in the Halloween level batch.
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where you could launch your character if you would use the grappling hook in a corner. (We also removed all high-scores that used this trick).
[*]Fixed a multiplayer bug where there would be no new level selected after one is finished.
[/list]


[b]Community highlights:[/b]
Our favorite video this month came from Kevin Regamey, who managed to [url=http://www.twitch.tv/otdq/c/5262539]completely break the game[/url] in several different ways! Unfortunately for you, these bugs have been fixed now ;)
